title: The conclusion of the elimination theorem, as a predicate on the data
statement: Let $S$ be qcqs, let $X$ and $Y$ be qcqs $S$-schemes with $Y\to S$ separated and of finite type, let $U\subseteq V\subseteq X$ be dense open subschemes whose open immersions into $X$ are quasi-compact, let $p\colon Y\to X$ be a morphism and let $f\colon U\to Y$ be a section of $p$ over $U$. We say that *the conclusion of [thm-nagata-conrad-elimination] holds for the data $(X,U,V,p,f)$* when there exists a $V$-admissible blow-up $\widetilde X\to X$ ([def-nagata-admissible-blowup]) such that $\widetilde X$ quasi-dominates $Y$ ([def-nagata-conrad-quasi-domination]) in a manner extending $f\colon U\to Y$.

source.place: the conclusion of the statement of thm-nagata-conrad-elimination, order 220; the predicate that lemma-nagata-conrad-blowup-base-change-reduction and lemma-nagata-conrad-closed-target-reduction refer to

created.why: breaks the cycle between thm-nagata-conrad-elimination and the two reduction lemmas, whose statements refer to the theorem's conclusion as a predicate (coord/ledger.md)
